beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Spring entrance from zero — the soft damping is the whole character. Overshoot spring: low damping, the mark overshoots past itself then corrects. That over-correction is a design choice. Draw-on stroke in terracotta, then fill. Mask wipe and iris open. Four first impressions.

Your turn. Paste this: animate my initials mark with a spring entrance, then show the same entrance as a draw-on stroke — and tell me which one feels authored and which one feels generated. The answer is in the timing, not the shape.
Bear Brown initials, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
